Summary: DEF-1408: Display defects on the Broadcom page: MAP shows no admitted-relationship count and prints its empty-field caption over the relationship labels; briefs print a double period after names ending in a full stop
Description: 1) Original intent: the MAP and the brief report the subject's admitted relationships and a stated absence of formation legibly and consistently (KRYL-1403, KRYL-1404). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the MAP field header shows the subject's admitted relationship count (6 for Broadcom) when relationships exist and no formation does, and '—' only when nothing was received or the subject has none; (b) with admitted relationships drawn and no formation, the 'No formation established' statement is a single line at the top of the plot, not the centred paragraph over the relationship labels; with no relationships the existing centred paragraph is unchanged; (c) a name that ends in a full stop ('Broadcom Inc.') is not followed by a second one in the brief, packet and domain-tab sentences; (d) no geometry, colour or layout change to the locked MAP. 3) Current implementation state: found on the live Broadcom page 2026-10-11 (header '—' next to '6 admitted', caption overlapping the Vanguard and Capital rows, 'Inc..'); fixed on Dev: public/structure-field.html (integrityText, caption branch), src/engine/sentenceend.js, structuralbrief.jsx, targetpacket.jsx, domainsubstratetabs.jsx; verified on the live page (header 6, caption at the top, no double period, no page errors). 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1403, KRYL-1404, MAP v3 lock (label and data text only). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes. Status: opened, built and in Review 2026-10-11.
